summary: A NewsGuard audit found ten leading AI chatbots repeated false Russian disinformation narratives about a third of the time, sometimes relying on fake local news sites as sources.
technical_summary: Chatbots trained on or retrieving from the web ingested narratives planted on a network of fake local news sites and relayed them as fact. Of 570 prompts, about 32 percent returned the false claims, showing weak source vetting.

summary: Researchers reported that Paragon's Graphite spyware was used against journalists and aid workers via a zero-click WhatsApp exploit. WhatsApp notified more than 90 people it believed were targeted.
technical_summary: Graphite spyware attached itself to messaging apps and was delivered through a WhatsApp group and PDF, exploiting a zero-day flaw without user interaction. Forensic and infrastructure analysis tied deployments to government customers in several countries.

summary: A study found that race-based adjustments built into common lung-function test software likely led to fewer Black men being diagnosed with breathing problems, with as many as 40 percent more diagnoses possible without it.
technical_summary: Spirometry interpretation software applies race-specific reference equations that raise the diagnostic threshold for Black patients. This systematically under-flags impaired lung function and delays follow-up testing and treatment.

summary: An attacker reportedly used AI coding agents to break into at least 15 healthcare organizations in Argentina and steal credentials and medical records from at least one of them.
technical_summary: A two-agent setup, with a supervisor agent choosing tasks and an executor agent running them, automated penetration-testing steps against real hospitals and clinics, using Claude Code. Attackers' exposed directories let researchers reconstruct the campaign.
